description: This file defines a RecyclerView Adapter (CartAdapter) for displaying shopping cart items and headers in an Android application. It manages view types for headers and items, provides diffing logic, handles view creation/binding, and includes event callbacks for user interactions such as incrementing, decrementing, and removing cart items.

classes.name: CartAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView Adapter managing a list of CartRow objects, which can be headers or items, with diffing and view type management for an online shopping cart interface.

classes.name: CartAdapter.HeaderVH
classes.description: ViewHolder for header views, responsible for displaying category headers in the cart list.

classes.name: CartAdapter.ItemVH
classes.description: ViewHolder for cart item views, handling display of product details and user interaction buttons.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Provides a stable ID for each item, based on header category or productId.

methods.name: getItemViewType
methods.description: Returns the view type (header or item) based on the CartRow type.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates ViewHolder instances for header or item views.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to header or item ViewHolders at a given position.

methods.name: shouldHideHeaderAt
methods.description: Determines if a header should be hidden based on its position and following items.

methods.name: findAdapterPositionForProduct
methods.description: Finds the adapter position of a cart item with a specific product ID.

methods.name: getCartItemAt
methods.description: Retrieves the CartItem at a specific adapter position if applicable.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binding method in ViewHolders to set data and handle user interactions.
